image.description: The hypercert visual representation as a URI or image blob.

rights.description: A strong reference to the rights that this hypercert has. The record referenced must conform with the lexicon org.hypercerts.claim.rights.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created

locations.description: An array of strong references to the location where activity was performed. The record referenced must conform with the lexicon app.certified.location.

workScope.description: Work scope definition. Either a strongRef to a work-scope logic record (structured, nested logic), or a free-form string for simple or legacy scopes. The work scope record should conform to the org.hypercerts.helper.workScopeTag lexicon.

description.description: Optional longer description of this activity claim, including context or interpretation. Rich text annotations may be provided via `descriptionFacets`.

contributors.description: An array of contributor objects, each containing contributor information, weight, and contribution details.

shortDescription.description: Short summary of this activity claim, suitable for previews and list views. Rich text annotations may be provided via `shortDescriptionFacets`.

descriptionFacets.description: Rich text annotations for `description` (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc).

shortDescriptionFacets.description: Rich text annotations for `shortDescription` (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc).

main.description: A hypercert record tracking impact work.

contributionWeight.description: The relative weight/importance of this contribution (stored as a string to avoid float precision issues). Must be a positive numeric value. Weights do not need to sum to a specific total; normalization can be performed by the consuming application as needed.

contributionDetails.description: Contribution details as a string via org.hypercerts.claim.activity#contributorRole, or a strong reference to a contribution details record.

contributorIdentity.description: Contributor identity as a string (DID or identifier) via org.hypercerts.claim.activity#contributorIdentity, or a strong reference to a contributor information record.

workScopeString.description: A free-form string describing the work scope for simple or legacy scopes.

contributorIdentity.description: Contributor information as a string (DID or identifier).
